entries.reason: AiConnectionSelect compares c.status against the technical connection-status enum connected. The label output is a translated reconnectName message or the saved user-provided c.name; the enum literal itself is never rendered.

AiProviderSetup displayLabel compares the provider ID against gateway. This technical provider discriminator selects the translated providerSetup.setup.gateway message; gateway is not rendered by this conditional.

AiProviderSetup displayLabel compares the provider ID against local. This technical provider discriminator selects the translated providerSetup.setup.local message; local is not rendered by this conditional.

useLocalAiLogin errorMessage uses the message property name in a TypeScript union guard ("message" in error). The property name is never rendered; output preserves the provider diagnostic or selects an already translated localErrors entry.

AgentProviderConnection errorMessage uses the message property name in a TypeScript union guard ("message" in error). The property name is never rendered; output preserves the provider diagnostic or selects an already translated localErrors entry.
ExternalObjectStatusIcon compares the canonical liveness enum against fresh; output is the translated status label and optional translated liveness. The enum value is not rendered.
ExternalObjectStatusIcon compares the canonical liveness enum against unknown; output is the translated status label and optional translated liveness. The enum value is not rendered.
SiblingLink compares the navigation direction against previous to select one of two translated aria labels. The technical direction value is not rendered.
TaskTreeControlDialog compares its action mode against restore to select the translated restore-tasks plural family. The action discriminator is not rendered.
IssueProperties compares the execution stage type against review to select translated reviewer or approver search placeholders. The stage enum is not rendered.
IssueProperties compares runtimeActionMessage against the canonical run action to display its translated completion notice. The action identifier is not rendered.
IssueProperties compares runtimeActionMessage against the canonical stop action to display its translated service notice. The action identifier is not rendered.
IssueProperties compares runtimeActionMessage against the canonical restart action to display its translated service notice. The action identifier is not rendered.
AttributionAvatar compares the technical role against assignee to select the translated assignee or originating-agent label. This is a discriminator, not visible copy.
IssueDetailActivityTab checks the BCP 47 locale identifier ru to select Russian USD number formatting. The locale code is not rendered.

IssueDetailActivityTab preserves the original four-decimal English USD amount format. Russian uses Intl currency formatting; the dollar symbol and number are monetary data, not an untranslated sentence.
TaskDetailSurface compares the canonical workMode against ask to select a translated mode tooltip. The mode identifier is not rendered.

CsvPreview compares the parser diagnostic against its existing canonical incomplete-quoted-field message. The matching branch renders taskPanels.csv.incomplete; unknown diagnostic text remains literal. The comparison operand is not displayed.
FileViewerMetadataRow compares the canonical previewKind enum text to select taskPanels.viewer.kind.text. The enum remains unchanged; the displayed label is translated.
FileViewerMetadataRow compares the canonical previewKind enum image to select taskPanels.viewer.kind.image. The enum remains unchanged; the displayed label is translated.
FileViewerMetadataRow compares the canonical previewKind enum video to select taskPanels.viewer.kind.video. The enum remains unchanged; the displayed label is translated.
FileViewerMetadataRow compares the canonical previewKind enum unsupported to select taskPanels.viewer.kind.unsupported. The enum remains unchanged; the displayed label is translated.

FileViewerSheet.handleCopyContent stores the CopyFeedback code dataCopied for a base64 payload. copyMessages resolves it to taskPanels.viewer.copy.dataCopied during render; storing the code preserves live locale changes without repeating clipboard work.

FileViewerSheet.handleCopyContent stores the CopyFeedback code contentsCopied for a text payload. copyMessages resolves it to taskPanels.viewer.copy.contentsCopied during render; the code is not user-visible copy.
FileViewerSheet.announcementText compares the announcement kind copy to select the translated copyMessages entry. The discriminator itself is never rendered.
FileViewerSheet.announcementText compares the announcement kind loaded. That branch renders the current load message supplied by FileContentViewer, not this technical discriminator.
FileViewerSheet.announcementText compares the announcement kind error before resolving a local translated fallback or preserving a raw diagnostic. The discriminator is not display text.

IssueDocumentsSection.errorMessage uses the property-presence guard message in error to distinguish a raw server diagnostic from a local error code. It renders error.message or the translated errorMessages entry; the property name is not shown.

DocumentCard displays Markdown as the technical format name when no revision is supplied. It is intentionally unchanged in Russian; the revision-bearing sentence uses taskPanels.card.markdownRevision.

SidePanelTabs compares its live-announcement kind moved and renders taskPanels.tabs.moved with the current tab label and position. This internal discriminator is not displayed or persisted as a translated label.
SidePanelTabs compares its live-announcement kind closed and renders taskPanels.tabs.closed. The state code itself is not user-facing text.
SidePanelTabs compares its live-announcement kind lastClosed and renders taskPanels.tabs.lastClosed. The state code preserves the last-tab focus behavior independently of language.

TaskBrowserPanel.load stores the local failure code disconnected rather than translated prose. The message expression renders taskPanels.browser.disconnected; retaining the code lets language changes update the error without another viewer request.
TaskBrowserPanel.action stores the local failure code actionFailed. The message expression renders taskPanels.browser.actionFailed without repeating the browser control mutation.
TaskBrowserPanel.message compares the local error code disconnected to select taskPanels.browser.disconnected. The comparison operand is not rendered; raw browser.error remains literal.
TaskBrowserPanel.message compares the local error code actionFailed to select taskPanels.browser.actionFailed. The comparison operand is not rendered; raw browser.error remains literal.

SnippetLine compares the canonical snippet field with document to select its title tooltip. The literal is a discriminator, not rendered copy. The tooltip preserves the user-provided fallbackLabel; the visible document chip uses searchUi.result.document.

groupInboxWorkItems compares groupBy with the canonical workspace value to choose its display-label resolver. The discriminator is not rendered. Translation happens after canonical grouping and sorting, preserving group keys, order and custom names.

groupInboxWorkItems compares groupBy with the canonical assignee value to choose its display-label resolver. The discriminator is not rendered. Translation happens after canonical grouping and sorting, preserving group keys, order and custom names.

ItemVerdictSegmentedControl compares the canonical verdict enum against approve to choose a translated action or validation message. This discriminator is not rendered and remains unchanged in submitted verdict payloads.

ItemVerdictSegmentedControl compares the canonical verdict enum against reject to choose a translated action or validation message. This discriminator is not rendered and remains unchanged in submitted verdict payloads.

RequestItemVerdictsCard compares the canonical verdict enum against approve to choose a translated action or validation message. This discriminator is not rendered and remains unchanged in submitted verdict payloads.

RequestItemVerdictsCard compares the canonical verdict enum against reject to choose a translated action or validation message. This discriminator is not rendered and remains unchanged in submitted verdict payloads.
QuestionForm compares the stored action discriminator against submit to select the translated submit or cancel failure. The action identifier is not rendered.
TaskChatRichInput uses the message property name in a union guard to preserve a provider diagnostic or select a translated upload fallback. The property name is not rendered.
